needs.proposedSignature: AsEnters: { kind: 'devour'; filter: Filter; times: number }  // 'As this creature enters, you may sacrifice any number of <filter>. It enters with <times> times that many +1/+1 counters on it.'
needs.semantics: An as-enters replacement (CR 614.1c): before the permanent enters, its controller may sacrifice any number of permanents matching `filter`; the object then enters with `times * n` +1/+1 counters, through `addCounters` so counter replacements still apply. `filter` defaults to creatures ('Devour 2'), and the printed word supplies it for 'Devour land N' / 'Devour Food N'. The sacrificed set should be bound so a card can read it later.
